claim: On Aug 29, 2026 Kinesis Data Streams started to deliver streaming data directly to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets. This is not examinable yet.
question: Can Kinesis Data Streams deliver data to S3 without Firehose, and since when?

values.display: delivers streaming data directly to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets

qualifiers.scope: Kinesis data streams in On-demand Standard or On-demand Advantage mode
qualifiers.condition: not supported in provisioned mode; announced after the exam-readiness cutoff of the book, so not examinable yet

evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now delivers streaming data directly to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets, providing the easiest way to ingest and deliver streaming data to S3 without building or managing delivery pipelines.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams announces data delivery to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets

note: NOT EXAMINABLE YET (GA after 2026-07-15). The 2026-08-29 What's New post is not in the change feed. Goes in 'Changed recently' only. Firehose remains the answer for transformation, format conversion and non-S3 destinations.
